gaps.explanation: Statement (Exhibit H, p6) Total operating disbursements/depreciation 8,310 (Water 7,061 + Sewer 1,249) includes Depreciation 2,767 (Water 1,755 + Sewer 1,012). The detail lines come from Schedule 3 (p10), budgetary cash basis: Water 5,306 + Sewer 237 = 5,543, which excludes depreciation (Water 7,061 - 1,755 = 5,306; Sewer 1,249 - 1,012 = 237). Schedule 4 (p11) prints the reconciliation: Actual 8,310, Adjustment to Budgetary Basis (2,767) for Depreciation, Actual on Budgetary Basis 5,543. 8,310 - 5,543 = 2,767 exactly = depreciation (non-cash). Printed basis difference; no fix.
